mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper provides literature background that lipopeptide antimicrobial mechanisms can involve membrane interaction, but it does not directly assay membrane permeabilization for gageostatins A-C.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote to direct_mechanism; this paper reports activity assays and structural characterization, not a direct mechanism assay.
